scope: Design review only; no campaign/controller mutations
title: Quasi-2D hydrofoil: numerical verification and mesh selection
purpose: A finite, evidence-led research discussion page, separate from the operational dashboard.

visual_system.layout: 1160px max width; 48px desktop gutters; 20px mobile; single-column sections with occasional two-column plots
visual_system.type: Segoe UI/Arial; body16px/1.5; scientific table14px minimum; section24px; page title32px
restrictions: No gradients, decorative cards, shadows, KPI theatre or AI/promo subtitles
No whole-dashboard raster images; recompose primary data as readable tables/SVG
Colour is redundant with line style, shape and label
No tool, controller PID, resume command, private publisher or CPU operational details in main narrative
Do not auto-refresh while presenting; show fixed as-of timestamp and manual refresh

sections.heading: Current evidence
content: One-sentence research question: Which economical mesh and solver configuration preserve the hydrofoil forces?
Compact setup line: NACA66-012, alpha0deg, U18m/s, c1.19m, submergence2m, depth24m, span20mm/onecell, SST+VOF
Small accurate foil/free-surface schematic
Three quantitative findings with scope, not generic green pass cards
Clearly state selection pending if no supported mesh is selected

sections.heading: Experiment sequence
content: Two lanes: mesh-design relationships and numerical-state branches
Each node: identifier, changed control, compact result, status; links to data details
Label connectors as design change or restart from; chronology is not solver ancestry
Mobile replaces wide graph with semantic nested lists; desktop retains editable/readable SVG or CSS nodes
Known family distinction wall-function vs low-y+ remains visible

sections.heading: Time integration and inner convergence
content: One shared M04 checkpoint fan-out to T01–T04; settings table4rows
Main comparison table uses same2.042–2.242s window: pair, changed variable, deltaCD, deltaCL, measured cost
Original M04 vsT01 placed separately as continued-drift evidence: different timewindows, not temporal-order effect
Show final conservation and inner-monitor checks separately from force sensitivity; no unsupported global 'validated' banner
Time order and FifthOrderVofWave are different concepts

sections.heading: Mesh sensitivity
content: Two panels: low-y+ primary focus and wall-function context; avoid one yaxis flattening low-y+CD variation
Plot means with identifiable mesh labels, not latest instantaneous samples
Use unconnected markers for cross-family or non-directional mesh changes; design links are not convergence fits
Compact change table fromM07→M08→M09: sixchangedtargets, prismsettingssharedonce; donotduplicateunchangedboxes
Primary comparison rows include deltaCD,deltaCL,pressureFx,viscousFx,cells,cost with reference named
M08/M07 currentlyonefinerconfirmation; nofinalselection fromthatpairalone

sections.heading: Flow and wall resolution
content: At most three well-sized scientific panels: pressureCp, actual streamlines/pressure field, wall-y+ distribution
Every figure names mesh, accepted saved timestamp, quantityunits and common colour scale
Instantaneous fields explicitly distinguished from force-windowmeans
Use y+ area distribution/p95 and TEcoverage, not just maxy+

sections.heading: Findings and unresolved checks
content: Short evidence-backed statements; observedresult vs interpretation vs pendingcheck in separate columns
OriginalM04 accumulateddrift vs localstoppingcriterion is an importantdiscussionpoint
State why M06cellcount cannotserve as refinement ofM08 inwallnormaldirection
Cost comparisons contextualised by samehardware/settings and actualphysicaltimeadvanced

sections.heading: Wave campaign
content: Separate planned section; C01,W01,W02, W013lambda sensitivity first; extraW03–W08second
FifthOrderVofWave,24mdepth,U18,headwaves; secondordertime withtesteddt separately
No blank plots or projectedforceclaims; showprepared/running/resultavailable statusonly
Matchedcalm,propagation/amplitude/phase/reflection/time checksbeforewaveforcecomparisons

sections.heading: Data and definitions
content: Per-case local.sim links, meanwindow,coefficientreferencearea/density/velocity/sign conventions
Machine-readable provenance manifest and generated timestamp
Print-readable source IDs; detailhistory preserved outside the presentation narrative

mesh: Local LE/TE refinement concept; not built
lineage.warning: T01/T02/T03/T04 did not restart sequentially from each other; a sequential arrow chain would misstate experiment design.

readability_tests: 1360x900 and1920x1080: no cut labels, maincomparisons legible withoutzoom, no overlay ongraph
390x844: no documenthorizontaloverflow; primaryfindings andtree readablewithout sidewaysscroll; onlydetailedtables may scrolllocally
Labelbounding-box intersectiontest on all plots; no tiny datalabels
Hover emphasis not required to read exported/print charts
PrinttoPDF: landscape/A4 orexplicitpages; nofigure/table truncation; repeatedtableheaders; nohalfnode pagebreaks
Visual inspection of actual screenshots is required, not DOMwidth checksalone
All displayedmeans match persisted accepted windows; runningvalues never occupy acceptedmeans column
